name: Callout
description: Mortar documentation callout, using central semantic tokens.

props.title: string (visible lead-in that names the note; defaults to the tone's word)
props.id: string (the root element's id, e.g. an in-page link target)
props.className: string (layout only: margins or grid placement)
props.tone: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" (default neutral; the default title is Note, Note, Tip, Warning or Caution)

contract.usage: Import { Callout } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
